biotools.summary: NP_Fingerprints is a Python package for computing molecular fingerprints, designed for evaluating their performance on natural product chemical space. The tool addresses the challenges of encoding natural products and provides an open-source solution for computing various fingerprints and analyzing their suitability for bioactivity prediction.
